step1.title: Create a mission
step1.body: A mission is your top-level goal. Tap + to create one: from scratch, from a template, or via AI.

step2.title: Agenda / Goals
step2.body: "Agenda" is a strategic view of your day. "Goals" lists every mission with progress and momentum.

step3.title: Mission card
step3.body: Progress, momentum (↗/→/↘), deadline and mini-stats. Tap to open the mission.

step4.title: List / Map
step4.body: Inside a mission: "List" — the hierarchy of sub-goals and tasks. "Map" — a visual graph.

step5.title: Sub-goals & Fog of War
step5.body: A mission breaks into stages. Fog of War hides future stages — unlock them as you go.

step6.title: Tasks
step6.body: Tasks are concrete steps. Check them off, assign weight, link dependencies.

step7.title: AI decomposition
step7.body: AI automatically breaks a mission into sub-goals, tasks and milestones. Requires processing consent.

step8.title: Quick entry
step8.body: The bottom bar instantly adds a sub-goal, task or milestone. Switch the type on the left.

step9.title: Tactical Map
step9.body: A visual graph of your mission. Drag nodes, add notes and connections. Tools on the right: search, zoom, auto-layout.

step10.title: Edit mode
step10.body: Turn on map edit mode to add notes, markers, images and connectors directly onto the canvas.

complete.title: COURSE COMPLETE
complete.body: You've mastered the Planning module. Good luck on your operations, operative.
